parse_multichase_fairness_output: parse multichase fairness benchmark output to extract avg and stdev latency metrics for unrelaxed and relaxed atomic increments
collect_fairness_from_line: collect fairness avg and stdev values from a single output line using regex pattern matching
initialize_fairness_parser: initialize a MultichaseFairnessParser instance with zeroed totals and a fairness count of 5 iterations
extract_avg_latency_metrics: extract average latency metrics for unrelaxed and relaxed atomic increment operations from benchmark stdout
extract_stdev_latency_metrics: extract standard deviation latency metrics for unrelaxed and relaxed atomic increment operations from benchmark stdout
